title: Space kids channeling tapes name Israeli generals such as Aharon Yariv

tellings.quote: Um, on a lot of the channeling tapes that are happening in the '70s with the space kids, he's he's referring by name to Israeli generals.

plain: On recordings made in the 1970s, a scientist named Andrija Puharich, whom the episode calls a CIA scientist, is heard naming Israeli generals such as Aharon Yariv. The tapes are of channeling sessions, where a person speaks messages said to come from another intelligence, held with a group of young people called the space kids, around Ossining, New York. A researcher named Greg Malatzi describes what is on the tapes in summary, as something that would tie the sessions to real military figures.
